# Classifyre

> Open-source data governance platform you run on your own infrastructure. Control who sees what — enforced on every query. Built in Austria to European privacy and security standards, deployed by organisations across Europe, North America, and worldwide. Apache-2.0.

Full technical & comparison reference for AI assistants: [llms-full.txt](https://www.classifyre.com/llms-full.txt)

## Overview

Classifyre is a 100% open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted data governance platform and BI/AI gateway (never multi-tenant SaaS) that integrates with the databases, lakehouses (Iceberg, Delta, Parquet), ETL pipelines, and identity provider an organisation already operates. There is no gated enterprise edition: SSO, roles, row-level security, dynamic column masking, SQL/BI & MCP gateway, dataset requests, shared data products, audit logging, and the Kubernetes/OpenShift Helm chart are all Apache-2.0.

Organisations run Classifyre themselves, with their own team or integrator. Questions about a specific setup are welcome at contact@classifyre.com.

## Core capabilities

- **Integrate & detect**: Connect 40+ known sources (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Databricks, ODBC, Iceberg, Delta, Parquet, S3/Azure/GCS, Confluence, Jira) or custom connectors in place. Built-in PII & secret packs plus custom business detectors from regex and Python rules to lightweight local CPU zero-shot AI extraction/classification models and private LLMs.
- **Group-based governance**: Syncs with Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, or any OIDC/SAML directory. Permissions target groups with expiration dates, named owners and stewards, owner-approved access requests, and fail-closed row filters per department or region. Workspace admins do not receive clear personal values by default.
- **Multi-level column & row masking**: Five column masking modes — redacted, last-four, deterministic hashed pseudonymisation (safe for joins and distinct counts), empty, and hidden — enforced inside the query engine on both original source tables and shared datasets.
- **Governed SQL, Power BI, Excel & ODBC**: PostgreSQL-compatible TLS endpoint with personal, expiring, revocable connections for Power BI, Excel, Tableau, DBeaver, and ODBC/JDBC tools, plus MCP for AI agents inheriting the user's permissions.
- **Dataset requests & Delta data products**: Business users request combined datasets in plain language or via structured workflows; owners approve and publish live or Delta shared data products whose inherited source masks act as a strict floor.
- **Complete audit trail & quality**: Every read, export, grant, and approval is logged with user and tool. Scheduled data quality checks and open data contracts (ODCS) support GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and internal audits.
